text: Jev-powered paid data marketplace: agents find Solana data providers and pay per call from $0.01. Peer x402 data seller; AgentReader company/KYB/SEC routes are complementary off-chain registry layer.
Pay-per-call data is the agent economy — cites Long Events $0.005 USDC/MCP. Worries junk data at cheap prices. High-signal buyer/educator; reply with sourced registry data + free ?preview=1.
Exact buyer intent: research agent may need a company database + news + paid API in one task; wants budget approval not per-purchase. Perfect fit for /kyb /uk-company /us-sec over x402.
Meryal: agent pays per request over x402 with per-payment/session/day caps and kill switch. Platform that needs real data sinks behind payment rails — company/KYB/SEC fit.
Pay-per-call with signed receipt binding answer bytes to payment is the right shape for agent APIs. Technical peer; good soft reply showing AgentReader preview+paid twin + receipt model.
Searched 1,500 SEC 10-Ks for AI-agent risk warnings (52 companies). Heavy SEC/EDGAR consumer — soft reply with /us-sec keyless x402 as scraping alternative.

x402 payment size analysis: tiny per-call vs escrow for larger. Thought-leader on agent payments; good soft mention of fixed-price registry routes + free preview.

PromptShield $0.002 USDC x402 content gate for agent-browsed HTML. Peer on x402 content safety; complementary to our clean markdown/meta routes.
House Party Protocol: agents already pay for what they use; x402 live, payment is part of the request. Platform that could surface or consume data APIs.
Chainalysis mapped AI agent buys by country via public x402 payments (138M+ on Base). Distribution/awareness; useful quote-reply with AgentReader as real data seller.
Lightning on x402: open standard using HTTP 402 so AI agents make automatic micropayments (stablecoins focus). Education angle for pay-per-call registry APIs.
OpenAny: one key for 160+ models + 3000+ APIs, pay per call. Agent stack needing data APIs — possible distribution peer for company/KYB routes.
Would you send money to a stranger with no name/history? AI agents get asked that constantly — identity (8004) angle. Soft reply: registry KYB before agent spends.
